raw_response:
Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a dense, homogeneous opacity ("white-out") of the right hemithorax with a contralateral (leftward) mediastinal shift, which is the classic radiographic presentation of a massive pleural effusion pushing structures away. The appropriate next step in management is thoracentesis to drain the fluid and obtain a diagnostic sample.
